testroom.name: BOO! Battle Simulator Testroom
testroom.next_up: Queue the pre-roll callouts — Ember Force (SWARM!), Smithy (FORGE!), Maximo (NAP!), and Mother Nature (SEASONS!) all call `showAbilityCallout` directly in `doPreRollSetup`, so when two of them fire the same round (e.g., Red Ember Force vs. Blue Mother Nature), the second callout instantly stomps the first; convert these to `queueAbility` with a pre-roll queue block and drain before the dice roll fires.
testroom.after_that: Audit the `doTeamRoll` path for the second-click case (B.phase === 'rolling') — when the KO-swap guard was broken, the `btn.classList.add('locked')` and `doTeamRoll` calls outside the `if (B.phase === 'ready')` block still fired; verify those outer lines are also safe when the phase has been interrupted.

feed.summary: Fixed `rollReady` silently rolling dice during an Ember-Force-triggered KO-swap — the old guard only caught `phase === 'over'`, so when Ember Force killed the active ghost with replacements still available, `phase` became `'ko-swap'`, the check was missed, phase was overwritten to `'rolling'`, and dice fired while the KO-swap picker was on screen; changed the guard to `phase !== 'ready'` so any mid-pre-roll interruption (game-over, ko-swap, or future states) aborts the roll.
feed.next_up: Queue the pre-roll callouts — Ember Force (SWARM!), Smithy (FORGE!), Maximo (NAP!), and Mother Nature (SEASONS!) all call `showAbilityCallout` directly in `doPreRollSetup`, so when two of them fire the same round (e.g., Red Ember Force vs. Blue Mother Nature), the second callout instantly stomps the first; convert these to `queueAbility` with a pre-roll queue block and drain before the dice roll fires.
feed.after_that: Audit the `doTeamRoll` path for the second-click case (B.phase === 'rolling') — when the KO-swap guard was broken, the `btn.classList.add('locked')` and `doTeamRoll` calls outside the `if (B.phase === 'ready')` block still fired; verify those outer lines are also safe when the phase has been interrupted.

feed.summary: Fixed Smithy dual-Forge callout collision — when both Ice Shards and Sacred Fires trigger the same round, the two `showAbilityCallout` calls now merge into a single combined message instead of the second silently stomping the first
feed.next_up: Audit the broken single-slash "comments" (`/ Helper:`, `/ Smithy`, `/ Mother Nature` etc.) in the JS — these stray `/` characters are latent parse hazards that look like division operators and will silently break the game under any minification or strict-mode build pass
feed.after_that: Pressure opponent choice — the opponent still auto-picks randomly when they have only 1 sideline ghost (no feedback to either player); the auto-path should show a brief callout splash *before* executing so both players see the effect land rather than noticing the swap already happened

feed.summary: Added a "PORPOISE — MISS" failure callout to Sylvia's dodge ability — previously ~83% of Sylvia's rounds showed zero visual feedback when her 1-in-6 dodge attempt failed, leaving both players silently confused about whether the ability had even fired; now the miss callout shows the exact roll number so everyone knows she tried.
feed.next_up: Smithy dual-Forge callout collision — if a team has ≥2 Ice Shards AND ≥2 Sacred Fires simultaneously, both `showAbilityCallout` calls fire back-to-back and the second instantly stomps the first (players never see the Ice Shard forge happen). Switch Smithy's Forge to use `queueAbility` so both conversions play sequentially through the cinematic queue.
feed.after_that: Add a "PORPOISE DODGE!" visual on the losing fighter card (brief shake or colored border flash) that reinforces which ghost attempted the dodge — the callout splash is center-screen and doesn't clearly tell new players *whose* ability fired; a `hitDamage`-style visual on the fighter card would anchor the effect to Sylvia's position.

feed.summary: Added a `🔨 Forge: ready/idle` status tag on the fighter card when Smithy (204) is on the team's sideline — amber-gold "Forge: ready" glows when ≥2 ice shards or ≥2 sacred fires are available (forge will fire), muted grey "Forge: idle" when resources haven't accumulated yet; players can now see Smithy's passive ticking without hunting the log or remembering they benched him.
feed.next_up: Fix the stray single-slash "comments" (`/ Helper:`, `/ Smithy`, `/ Mother Nature`) — these are latent JS parse hazards that look like division operators or regex starts; they should be `//` before a minification or strict-mode pass silently breaks the game.
feed.after_that: Audit the dual Mother Nature edge case — if pick logic doesn't prevent two teams from both drafting Mother Nature (366), the Winter loop's second iteration reduces a die count already reduced in the first; add a guard or confirm the pick screen correctly prevents duplicate legendary picks.

feed.summary: Implemented Smithy (204) Forge sideline ability — each round, if Smithy is on the sideline and the team has ≥2 Ice Shards or ≥2 Sacred Fires, both conversions automatically trigger (consuming 2 of each resource type to mint 1 Moonstone each), with a gold FORGE! callout and sideline-card pop animation; Smithy is now a fully playable 40th active card bridging Frost Valley's ice economy into Volcanic Activity's Moonstone plays.
feed.next_up: Audit the dual Mother Nature edge case — if both teams draft Mother Nature (currently possible since there's only one copy in the pool, but verify the pick logic prevents this), the Winter loop's second iteration reduces a count already reduced in the first; add a guard or confirm the pick screen correctly prevents duplicate legendary picks.
feed.after_that: Add a Smithy status tag on the team's resource panel when Smithy is on their sideline showing "🔨 Forge: ready" so players remember this passive is ticking each round — otherwise they may not notice the moonstone appeared and miss the strategic implication.

feed.summary: Made Healing Seed tooltip context-aware (shows current HP and explains "HP is already full — can't use now" when the tile is greyed out) and added a first-time-player-readable tooltip to the Lucky Stone tile explaining it's used post-roll to reroll any one die
feed.next_up: Add Smithy (204) "Forge" sideline ability — at round start, if Smithy is on the sideline and the team has ≥2 Ice Shards or ≥2 Sacred Fires, automatically convert 2 of either into 1 Moonstone; this is the last un-shelved "resource conversion" design in the set and fills empty design space around cross-resource economy
feed.after_that: Audit `doPreRollSetup` for the case where both teams have Mother Nature active simultaneously — the current loop iterates `[B.red, B.blue]` and each Winter reduces the opponent's count, but if both had MN active, the second loop iteration uses the already-reduced count for the opponent; verify this stacks correctly or add a guard

feed.summary: Added a persistent `🌙 Twilight Active · +1 Dmg` purple status tag on Dusk's fighter card once `B.round > 5` — players now get clear visual confirmation the late-game scaling has kicked in, instead of being confused when their damage number is unexpectedly higher than expected.
feed.next_up: Add "Round 1 — " to the opening narration in `startBattle` so the battle counter starts consistently at 1 (matching the "Round N — X vs Y" format used from Round 2 onward), which matters for Seasons tracking and Dusk's Twilight countdown.
feed.after_that: Audit the broken single-slash comment on the "Dusk (364)" line (`/ Dusk (364)` at line ~3321) — that stray `/` at the start of a line is a latent JS parse hazard that should be `//` before it bites during a minification or strict-mode pass.

feed.summary: Added a persistent color-coded season status tag to Mother Nature's fighter card — showing `🌸 Spring · +1 HP`, `☀️ Summer · +1 Dmg`, `🍂 Autumn · +1 Seed`, or `❄️ Winter · Opp −1 Die` at all times during battle so players never need to count rounds to know what's coming.
feed.next_up: Add a Dusk "⚡ Twilight Active" status tag on Dusk's fighter card once `B.round > 5` — identical pattern to the Mother Nature tag, one line of code, gives players clear visual confirmation that the +1 damage scaling has kicked in rather than wondering why the damage number was higher than expected.
feed.after_that: Add "Round 1 — " to the opening narration in `startBattle` so the battle counter starts consistently at 1 (matching the "Round N — X vs Y" format used from Round 2 onward), which matters for Seasons tracking and Dusk's Twilight countdown.

feed.summary: Implemented Dusk (364) Twilight — removed from SHELVED_IDS and added `+1 damage` on every win from Round 6 onward, with a queued `TWILIGHT!` callout splash; Dusk is now a fully playable 39th active card with a clean late-game scaling identity.
feed.next_up: Audit `B.round % 4` Seasons timing — the Winter status tag checks `B.round % 4 === 0` (rounds 4, 8, 12…) but verify this aligns exactly with when `doPreRollSetup` reduces the die count; an off-by-one where the tag shows on round 3 but Winter fires on round 4 (or vice versa) would silently confuse players about why their dice count changed.

feed.summary: Implemented Bumble (362) Pollinate from scratch — removed from SHELVED_IDS, added on-win resource logic (+2 seeds for Bumble's team, +1 to opponent), and queued a POLLINATE! callout splash; Bumble is now a fully playable 38th active card
feed.next_up: Audit `B.round % 4` Seasons timing — the Winter status tag and `doPreRollSetup` both check the same `B.round % 4 === 0` condition, but verify there's no off-by-one at game start (Round 1 = `1%4=1` → Spring) vs. the narration header which shows Round N after the increment; confirm players see "Winter" tag on exactly the same round that the die penalty fires
feed.after_that: Implement Dusk (364) Twilight — "After round 5: all your damage gains +1" is shelved and unimplemented; it's the simplest damage-scaling card in the set and would take ~5 lines (check `B.round > 5 && wF.id === 364`, bump damage, queue callout), making it the next natural un-shelve candidate

feed.summary: Removed Mother Nature (366) from SHELVED_IDS — six cycles of Seasons implementation (Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter) now actually fires in games; she appears on the pick screen as the 37th active card
feed.next_up: Audit `B.round % 4` Seasons timing edge case — the status tag and `doPreRollSetup` both check `B.round % 4 === 0` for Winter, but since `B.round` starts at 1 and increments at round END, Round 4 (first Winter) fires when `B.round === 4`; verify the status tag is visible on the "ready" phase of Round 4 (not Round 3), since `renderBattle` is called after `B.round++` in the reset path

feed.next_up: Add a `-1 Die (Winter)` status tag variant for Mother Nature (366) alongside the existing Timber check — when Mother Nature is active and it's Winter season (round % 4 === 3), the opponent should see the same `-1 Die` badge so they're never confused about their reduced dice count.

feed.summary: Added a `+N ⚡ Retribution` status tag on Knight Light's fighter card that shows the count of accumulated bonus dice pending for the next roll — previously players had no visual reminder after the callout flashed by, and were confused why they rolled extra dice.

feed.summary: Added `die-win-secondary` highlight to the tied matched dice in tiebreaker rounds — players can now see both the matched hand (dim amber glow) AND the decisive kicker (full gold pulse), telling the complete story of why someone won instead of just showing a single mystery die glowing.
feed.next_up: Pressure opponent choice — Death Howl's Pressure currently calls `doPressureSwap` with a random sideline pick; it should instead pause the game and show the *opponent* clickable sideline targets so *they* decide who enters, matching the forced-but-chosen intent of the ability.

feed.summary: Added a `showAbilityCallout` on Blackout miss — when Smudge names a number that the opponent doesn't roll, both players now see "BLACKOUT — MISS / Smudge named X — no dice matched!" instead of dead silence with only a buried log entry.
feed.next_up: Tiebreaker highlight polish — when the round ends on a cascading tiebreaker, the winner's matched dice (the tied pair) are left unhighlighted/neutral while only the decisive kicker glows; add a dimmer secondary highlight class to the matched dice so players understand the full picture of why someone won.
feed.after_that: Resources panel UX — the committed resource tiles show count as `2/3⚔` which is cryptic; add a `title` tooltip like `"2 of 3 Ice Shards committed — +2 damage if you win"` so players who hover can understand the mechanic without reading the log.

feed.summary: Fixed Blackout (Smudge 403) visual bug — blacked-out dice now disappear from the dice row immediately when the ability fires, instead of remaining on screen looking like they still count while the `highlightWinnerDice` function silently applies highlights to stale DOM elements
